title: Callvale after: queues between the steps and a topic for results
claim: Uploads wait in queues between the steps, and the transcript-ready topic sends each finished transcript to two queues.
alt: After: an upload to Amazon S3 sends an event to the uploads queue. The start-job function reads it and sends work to the convert queue. Conversion workers in an Auto Scaling group read the convert queue. The save-results function publishes to the transcript-ready topic, which sends a copy to the webhooks queue and the indexing queue. The convert queue has a dead-letter queue for repeated failures.

edges.label: event
edges.say: An upload to Amazon S3 sends an event to the uploads queue.

edges.label: polls
edges.say: The start-job function reads the uploads queue and sends conversion work to the convert queue.

edges.label: polls
edges.say: Conversion workers scale on the convert backlog and process each message.

edges.label: publish
edges.say: The save-results function publishes to the transcript-ready topic, which sends the message to each subscribed queue.

edges.label: repeated failures
edges.say: A consumer can receive a message a set number of times before it is moved to a dead-letter queue.
